name: AC-01 the file is the Kaggle format and nothing else
AC-02 every puzzle has exactly n squares, square_id 0..n-1
AC-03 coordinates are finite decimal literals
AC-04 no two squares in a puzzle overlap (SAT, all pairs)
AC-05 L is recomputed from the CSV, not trusted
AC-06 the total score is the sum of the per-puzzle scores
AC-07 the grid baseline is what the metric says it is
AC-08 no puzzle is worse than the grid
AC-09 the shipped packings reproduce every reported side
AC-10 every number quoted in REPORT.md exists in results.json
AC-11 the site is one self-contained file
AC-12 the README commands name files that exist
